title: Isandro and the Archive
author: Mara Vasquez
blurb: Ansel Iversen, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
